replacements.Cómo retrieval genera candidatos y una p: How retrieval generates candidates and a separate assembly policy decides freshness, authority, conflict, and grounding before evidence reaches the model
replacements.Recuperar candidatos es sólo el principi: Retrieving candidates is only the start: the application decides which evidence deserves to enter
replacements.La similitud ayuda a encontrar candidato: Similarity helps find candidates. It does not prove they are current, authoritative, mutually compatible, or sufficient to support a claim. The assembler applies those policies before building context.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable de retrieval, ensam: Scrollable diagram of retrieval, assembly, conflicts, and grounding
replacements.De una consulta a candidatos, contexto a: From a query to candidates, admitted context, and grounded claims
replacements.Una consulta se abre en retrieval léxico: A query fans out into lexical, semantic, and structured retrieval. Their results converge as candidates, not as truth. The assembly policy filters scope and permissions, checks version and freshness, separates authoritative from derived sources, and detects conflicts. Admitted evidence forms a bounded context for the model. Generated claims retain grounding links to evidence IDs; an unresolved conflict follows an abstain-or-escalate branch.
replacements.ranking propone; no autoriza: ranking proposes; it does not authorize
replacements.<strong>Recupera un conjunto amplio de c: Retrieve broadly; assemble only eligible evidence. A relevant result is still only a candidate. The final context must preserve version, authority, permissions, and conflicts; every material claim should be traceable to the evidence that actually entered Aₜ.
